name: So Pho - Tampines Mall
description: Delight in the casual and comfortable ambience at So Pho, accompanied by an array of authentic, halal-certified Vietnamese dishes in Singapore. From piping hot bowls of Phos to nourishing Bun Noodles and enticing Banh Mi, the options are endless. Pair your mains with refreshing Summer Rolls or innovative Vietnamese Pancakes for a more satisfying meal. Don’t forget to indulge in their Vietnamese Drip coffee and Coffee Jelly Ice Cream, perfect pick-me-ups at any time of the day!
